# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 91 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 50 | Coptic

---

## Saying 91

They said to him: "Tell us who you are so that we may believe in you." He said to them: "You read the face of the sky and of the earth, but you have not recognized the one who is before you, and you do not know how to read this present moment."

---

**Translator's Notes (EMET):**

- Parallel to Matthew 16:2-3 / Luke 12:54-56 (reading signs of weather); Thomas combines this with a challenge about recognizing Jesus
- "The face of the sky and of the earth" — the visible surface of cosmic phenomena
- "The one who is before you" — Jesus, standing in front of them; *prosopon* (face/presence)
- "This present moment" — **ⲡⲁⲓⲕⲁⲓⲣⲟⲥ** / *pai kairos*: "this kairos" — the opportune, decisive time
- The disciples can read natural signs but not the eschatological sign standing in front of them
